title: Mochizuki Honami — Turning Cherished Pages〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Neighborhood
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Pant... Pant... Pant...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It feels nice to be out in the sun, doesn't it, Shibao?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, look. The flowers over at that house are all blooming.

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Shibao looks like he's having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He must've really wanted to go for a walk. I mean, while we were doing our homework, he came over with his leash in his mouth.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, also... I think I made him wait a little too long.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, because I've recently been spending a lot of my time practicing for that reading event...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So much so that I've been asking the others in my family to walk him for me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
If that's the case, then he must be really happy about getting to go on a walk with you today, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Speaking of which, how are things coming along for that event?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, they're coming along well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Voice acting is incredibly challenging...
But Kusanagi's been giving me excellent advice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. I definitely want to hear how you sound.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, well...
It's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I do want you, Saki and Shiho to hear us rehearse before the event.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Is Shibao okay...?
He's kept looking at you this entire time, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe he's trying to say that he also wants to hear you read that story, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Is she right, Shibao?
Would you listen to me practice?

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. He's wagging his tail.
He really does seem happiest when he's with you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have a feeling that he'd also try to save you if anything happened to you, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like the protagonist from “The Star-Chasing Dog”.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is she right, Shibao? Would you do that for me?

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think he just said, “Yes!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so sweet of you, Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm not sure how I feel about you going on such a long journey by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I mean, you tire out so quickly during our walks... I'm worried that you'd get lost and never find your way home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Honestly, I'd rather save you instead of you having to save me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You would?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. No matter how arduous the journey is, I feel like I'd be able to take on anything for him.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was just thinking about how you and that dog in the story really are alike.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Especially how you'd do anything for someone you really care about.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, my heart isn't nearly as big as that dog's...
But I do appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because I've loved him and that story since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is he feeling jealous that you're talking about another dog like that...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry, Shibao.
You'll always be the dog I love the most.
